messages:
amanda (AE): Hey team — POC kickoff with FinReg EU next week. They want a short 3-hour demo window with ~120 concurrent sessions (mostly chat), peak ~60 req/s, avg sequence length ~350 tokens. Can we provision a temporary hosted burst and an ephemeral key scoped to the demo org? Need IP allowlist and token TTL 4h. Also they asked if we can failover to US if EU capacity is constrained.

carlos (Solutions Eng): We can do a scoped key with a higher qps limit for a timebox. Scoped keys support qps overrides + IP restrictions. Two quick checks: which model (and quantization) they want, and do they need streaming? Failover: routing can fallback to a compatible model in another region but latency might increase — worth confirming risk tolerance.

amanda (AE): Model is redwood-large-8b-quant (chat), streaming yes. Customer name: FinReg EU (internal id: finreg-eu). Demo window: 2026-04-28 13:00–16:00 CEST. Can we guarantee the 60 req/s peak? They're sensitive to throttling mid-demo.

sanjay (Infra Eng): Need to know expected tokens/sec and KV cache behavior. 350 tokens avg * 60 req/s => ~21k tokens/s peak. That influences GPU slot sizing and will determine whether hosted burst works or we recommend a short Dedicated trial. Also IP allowlist: give us the customer egress IPs.

amanda (AE): I only have their network team contact. Will ping for egress IPs now. They prefer hosted to avoid onboarding Dedicated. Billing question from procurement: is the burst pro-rated or will it be billed as overage at list rates?

carlos (Solutions Eng): Short answer: hosted overage shows up on the invoice as usage at standard hosted rates unless we create a custom PO/commit. For a one-off POC we can charge usage; if sales wants to absorb/demo credits we can set a coupon/credit. I can also create a scoped key with a hard qps cap and a labeled comment for billing.

amanda (AE): Sales prefers we provision and let them use credits for this POC. They asked if we can issue an ephemeral key that auto-revokes after the window and logs all calls for audit.

carlos (Solutions Eng): Yes — scoped ephemeral keys can be time-limited and tied to IP allowlist. We can enable request logging (trace id + user tag). Example scoped-key payload I can generate for ops:

```json
{
  "key_type": "scoped",
  "org": "finreg-eu",
  "qps": 80,
  "ttl": 14400, // 4h
  "allowed_ips": ["203.0.113.45"],
  "model": "redwood-large-8b-quant",
  "stream": true,
  "note": "eu-poc-2026-04-28, sales credit applied"
}
```

carlos (Solutions Eng): I'm proposing qps 80 headroom so we don't hit the cap at 60 req/s (bursty). We can lower to 60 if sales wants tighter control.

jess (CS): Security checklist: we need the customer to sign the data handling addendum and confirm no PHI in demo prompts. Also we should provide them with a short audit log export after the demo.

amanda (AE): Confirmed — FinReg signed the DPA already. They will avoid PHI. I'll get the IP list.

ops-bot: quota-change-request created -> QCR-8521; owner=carlos; region=eu-central-1; requested-qps=80; window=2026-04-28T11:30:00Z to 2026-04-28T15:30:00Z; status=pending

sanjay (Infra Eng): Quick note: if we can't secure enough EU capacity, routing fallback to us-west is possible but the RL will add ~60–120ms RTT; streaming might still be okay for demo but callouts depend on region. Also watch memory for long contexts — may need to bump instance type.

carlos (Solutions Eng): I'll provision the scoped ephemeral key and coordinate ops change. Amanda — once you confirm IPs, I'll finalize allowed_ips and set TTL to 4h starting 30m before window. I'll also tag the usage to sales credits so procurement isn't billed.

amanda (AE): IPs sent to ops via DM. Thanks — please confirm when key is created and share the curl snippet so I can run a quick smoke test.

ops-bot: quota-change-request QCR-8521 approved -> change-id CHG-4492; scoped-key created (partial): sk_scope_finregeu_1840123456; start=2026-04-28T11:30:00Z; end=2026-04-28T15:30:00Z

carlos (Solutions Eng): Smoke test curl (replace KEY):

```bash
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_scope_finregeu_1840123456" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-8b-quant","stream":true,"input":"Hello"}' \
  https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream
```

amanda (AE): Got it, will test and report back. Thanks for the quick turnaround :tada:

jess (CS): I'll prepare the audit export template and share post-demo.

amanda (AE): All set for now — will update if FinReg asks for Dedicated trial instead. Appreciate the help!
